name: No Promises
tagline: You never said you'd come. You always do.
epigraph: This glass holds grocery-store bitters. A Brooklyn liquor shop wasn't supposed to sell them.
glassware: small rocks glass (single old-fashioned, about 200 ml), one large ice cube
language_row: Wren's Resonance (v3): horoscope, swap and punch pass (swapped against *Out of Your Way*, *One Line*, *Accomplices* and *Next One's Mine*); no rationed Hero words; "amaro" glossed as "the bitter liqueur Italy makes from herbs" (Hester: Oxford AMARO pdf 98); every she/her is LeNell, never the guest; the neighbourhood left unnamed (the *Red Hook* cocktail is Milk & Honey's). ✓
sources: Studio fact card `_studio/fact-cards/lenell-smothers-red-hook.md` (Simonson, *A Proper Drink* pp. 237–239, with Smothers's 2014 email interview and Boelte's 2014 interview; *The Joy of Mixology* pdf 419; *Oxford Companion* SORGHUM pdf 1834, AMARO pdf 98, RED HOOK pdf 1623; *The Flavor Matrix* pdf 240; *Cocktail Codex* pp. 3–6). Room notes: `work/hero-outlaw/`.
names_note: **No Promises**, the room's pick, 3–0 (Wren's; Tomás moved from *Comes Good* because it praises where this recognises, and the closing line does the turning; Hester gave up *Hard to Find* because it leans towards the shop rather than the person). Also considered: *Comes Good*, *Hard to Find*, *End of the Street*, *Found Anyway* (out: *Anyway* is the Morale Booster's), *Out of the Way* (out: the Knight's *Out of Your Way*).
open_items: **Not veto-free on purpose:** Underberg is new to the ingredient table and Tomás classed it `nuts` on the safe side (secret recipe, no botanical list read; a herbal bitters can carry nutmeg). A published Underberg ingredient declaration would settle it, and also what Underberg is (country, herbs). The Hero family loses one planned veto-free row.

**Sorghum syrup** is Tomás's craft choice (the *Matrix* pairs the syrup family with grain); the reading claims nothing Southern for it. Its sugar figure (90 g/100 ml) is unsourced; the sweep holds in range at 100 g.
**Unsourced values:** straight rye at 40% (the recipe says 40–43%; 50% is OUT); the Underberg bottle size; sorghum syrup's availability outside the US South.

**Guards:** "when hardly anyone stocked rye" is Simonson's narration (never "when no one had rye"); the hire is never linked to the telling-off; the lease is not her sacrifice; Eric Seed's telling-off stays out (the Quest Seeker's); living person, quotes dated to 2014.
**Hester's note:** the y2 Notes row paraphrases "those things" where y2 says "many of those things" (dossier only; the guest text is right).
